#.label: Adyen local settings (preview)
#/properties/environment.label: Environment
#/properties/environment.description: Production is live. Sandbox is Adyen's test system. Mock is the Extenda Retail simulator, so nothing reaches Adyen.
#/properties/apiKey.label: API key
#/properties/apiKey.description: Used at start-up to point the terminal's status messages at the checkout. Needs the Adyen roles “Terminal settings read and write” and “Terminal advanced settings read and write”; Adyen Support must enable the second. Restart the terminal afterwards. Treat it like a password.
#/properties/encryptionKeyIdentifier.des: Name of the encryption key shared with Adyen. It must match the key set for the terminals.
#/properties/encryptionKeyPassphrase.des: At least 12 characters. Treat it like a password.
#/properties/encryptionKeyVersion.label: Key version
#/properties/encryptionKeyVersion.descri: Leave at 1 unless Adyen says otherwise.
#/properties/receiptLineWidth.label: Receipt width
#/properties/receiptLineWidth.descriptio: Characters per line on the card receipts the checkout prints. Default 42. Match the receipt printer.
#/properties/webhookPort.label: Status port
#/properties/webhookPort.description: Network port on the checkout where the terminal sends status messages. Four digits, for example 8888. Must be free on the checkout and open in the store network.
